description: Remix TypeScript starter with nested routing, loaders, and actions.

defaults.headline: Starter Foundry Remix App
defaults.subheadline: A Remix shell with loaders and actions ready for extension.

buildHints.whenToUse: Remix for full-stack React with nested routes, loader/action pattern, and progressive enhancement. Prefer when the product has deeply nested route trees or strong form-submission + server-mutation flows.
firstSteps: Install: `pnpm install` then `pnpm dev`. Remix uses file-based routing under `app/routes/` — dot-delimited filenames map to URL segments.
Loaders (server-only) run before render, actions handle form submits. Do not import server-only libraries into components directly — put them in `.server.ts` files.
gotchas: Remix 2.x is the current line; React Router v7 is the next major. Check the remix-run docs version for guide alignment.
Loaders throw Response objects for redirects/errors, NOT raw throws — `throw redirect(...)` / `throw json(...)` are the patterns.
